hints.title: Prefix Sum Difference Target Form
hints.text: A subarray from index j plus one to i sums to target k if and only if prefix[i] minus prefix[j] equals k.

hints.title: Earliest Prefix Sum Index Retention
hints.text: To maximize subarray length i minus j, store only the earliest occurrence of each prefix sum value.

hints.title: Running Sum Map Invariant
hints.text: Initialize map with zero at index negative one. Accumulate running sum. If running sum minus k exists in map, update maximum length. If running sum is not already in map, store its current index.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all subarray sums takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Caching earliest prefix sum positions provides constant-time complement lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should remember to retain only the earliest index for each cumulative sum to maximize length.
